label: KBS-SK-2005-GESTURES
full_name: Gestá a postoje pri svätej omši — smernice ku Pastierskemu listu KBS o gestách a držaní tela počas slávenia svätej omše
source_file_note: Text reconstructed from web search results. Original HTML at kbs.sk not accessible from current network environment.
adaptations_method: Separate document — NOT embedded in VSRM text. Referenced as footnote/note in master GIRM document.
binding: Binding for all Slovak dioceses (all Bishops' Conferences)

summary_en.universal_norm_confirmed: Adopts full VSRM §43 text verbatim for Slovakia.
summary_en.kde_je_zvyk_clause: Kneeling from Sanctus through end of Eucharistic Prayer applies only where that local parish custom already exists ('kde je zvyk'). NOT universally mandated in Slovakia.
summary_en.na_slovensku_zachovame: Slovakia retains the custom of kneeling before Communion when the Priest says Ecce Agnus Dei (Hla, Baranok Bozi). This kneeling counts as the reverential act before receiving; no separate kneeling is needed in the Communion procession. This IS universal for Slovakia.
summary_en.alleluia: Pastoral guidance: the faithful stand from the first sung note of the cantor or schola — the first sung syllable of the acclamation, not from any organ introduction.
summary_en.gospel_ambo: During the Gospel, those standing turn toward the ambo as a sign of personal reverence for Christ's Gospel (VSRM §133).
summary_en.sign_of_peace: The sign of peace is given soberly only to immediately neighbouring persons (VSRM §82).
